the development of novel immunoprevention strategies to prevent the development of cancer, with a particular focus on the development of vaccines to prevent breast cancer.
the development of new and improved vaccines against cancer, particularly breast cancer, and with the development of improved diagnostic tests for breast cancer.

the immune system can be harnessed to prevent breast cancer, and the same approach may be applicable to other cancers.
